STATIC LEARNING EDITION · entry

Parity

Group integers according to whether they can be made entirely of pairs.

Open interactive route Exact archive record

Manipulation

Supply an integer witness for an odd value: n = 2k + 1.

Pattern

Every integer belongs to the even or odd class under ordinary integer arithmetic.

Mechanism

The representation n = 2k or n = 2k + 1 makes a classification checkable and can choose a branch of an update rule.

Vocabulary

even
An integer of the form 2k for integer k.
odd
An integer of the form 2k + 1 for integer k.

Notation

n = 2k + 1
An integer witness k exhibits oddness.

Formal statement

Context: integers with ordinary arithmetic

For n in Z: n is even iff there exists k in Z with n=2k. n is odd iff there exists k in Z with n=2k+1.

Proof scope · worked-example

27 is odd.

  1. Choose the integer k = 13.
  2. Then 2k + 1 = 2 × 13 + 1 = 27.

This exhibits oddness for one integer; it is not a general result about Collatz orbits.

Predict, experiment, verify, transfer

Answers are available for self-study. An answer in this edition does not grant a credential or change archive verification.

predict · choice

Two kinds of integer.

Which integer is odd?

  1. 18
  2. 19
  3. 20
Hint

An odd integer has the form 2k + 1 for an integer k.

Answer and its scope
19

19 = 2 × 9 + 1. The classification can drive a piecewise update rule.

transfer · number

Supply the witness.

For 27 = 2k + 1, what integer k witnesses that 27 is odd?

Hint

Subtract one, then divide by two.

Answer and its scope
13

27 = 2 × 13 + 1. The definition becomes a checkable arithmetic witness.
